name: Mind's Eye
summary: The Mind’s Eye is an artifact held by Mai’Zoth, an ogre mage in Stranglethorn Vale. Its magic is feared for corrupting and strengthening those who wield it.

sections.title: The Ogre Mage
sections.body: Brother Nimetz believes Mai’Zoth used the Mind’s Eye to corrupt Kurzen. The ogre mage keeps the artifact within the Mosh’Ogg ogre mound in eastern Stranglethorn Vale. Nimetz fears its influence could corrupt others as well.

sections.title: A Choice for the Eye
sections.body: Kin’weelay seeks the Mind’s Eye as the only hope of saving Yenniku. After it is recovered, Kin’weelay means to bend its power to the Darkspears’ needs. Brother Nimetz plans to study the artifact and decide whether it can be used for good or must be destroyed.

faq.answer: The Mind’s Eye is an artifact held by the ogre mage Mai’Zoth. Its magic is said to make his power stronger and to corrupt others.
Mai’Zoth, an ogre mage, holds the Mind’s Eye deep within the Mosh’Ogg ogre mound in Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: What did the Mind’s Eye do to Kurzen?
faq.answer: Brother Nimetz believes Mai’Zoth used the Mind’s Eye to corrupt Kurzen. He fears its influence could corrupt others.

faq.q: Why does Kin’weelay want the Mind’s Eye?
faq.answer: Kin’weelay seeks the Mind’s Eye as the only hope of saving Yenniku, the Darkspear chief’s son.

faq.q: What will Brother Nimetz do with it?
faq.answer: Brother Nimetz plans to study the Mind’s Eye and decide whether it can be used for good or must be destroyed.
Mai’Zoth dwells within the Mosh’Ogg ogre mound in eastern Stranglethorn Vale.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, the Mind’s Eye concerns the Darkspears’ effort to save Yenniku, the chief’s son.
